correctness.rationale: PASS. Over every q=2^r, r>=1, polarization maps 10-dimensional quadratic forms onto 6-dimensional alternating forms with 4-dimensional kernel; on 4 variables a quadric is geometrically smooth iff its alternating polar form has full rank. The split Pfaffian P on six coordinates restricts anisotropically to exactly A(q)=q^4(q^3-1)(q-1)/2 two-planes (normalized norm-one and polar-one pair count). Each such polar plane has q^8 quadratic lifts, proving the first formula. The regular pencil admits the K=F_{q^2}-coordinate normal form and all lifts parametrized by a,b,c,d in K. Over the algebraic closure, independent conjugate supports make the Jacobian rank deficient precisely on radical lines; restricting both quadrics there yields singularity iff Delta=bd+(ad)^2+(cb)^2=0. Of Q^4 lifts with Q=q², exactly (Q²-1)(Q²-Q) have nonzero Delta, giving fraction (1-q^-2)(1-q^-4). A smooth 2-quadric complete intersection in P^3 is connected degree four genus one. Independently enumerated all 56 anisotropic polar planes over F2 and q2 total 14336; package checkers separately enumerate q2/q4 and geometric radical roots. The finite enumeration does not substitute for all-r proof.
